text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The fans congratulated me too, and I was 
able to make them smile!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It was as if the entire stands had burst 
into bloom!
choice_data_list: That's how incredible that run was!

Let's make everyone smile in full bloom 
next time too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so, so happy that you enjoyed 
it too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please keep training me so I can run like 
I did today again!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll do my best to bring joy to even 
more people!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna work hard at training 
again starting tomorrow!
